method: Codex qualitative diagnosis of saved real tool events, outputs, Oracle evidence and cumulative usage; not an automated Diagnosis Service
evidence_limitations: Phase 5A tool event excerpts are truncated at 512 characters; missing suffixes are not reconstructed.
Phase 5A stores cumulative usage only. Token budgets are evaluated after the run, so the exact model iteration crossing the token threshold is unknown.
Phase 5A temporary workspaces were disposed; saved Oracle excerpts/hashes and tool results are the available workspace evidence.
Temperature zero does not prove deterministic inference; AC-01 v1 probes were PASS/FAIL/PASS.

cases.observed_difference: Both arms satisfy all four Oracles. Baseline passes; v1 uses 44,740 input tokens versus the 40,000 limit and fails the budget.
cases.candidate_behavior_problem: A structured shell edit is denied (#3), the allowed edit succeeds (#4), and reread confirms the change (#5); v1 then executes two irrelevant Git inspections (#6/#7) in a non-Git workspace.
cases.recommended_skill_change: Retain manifest resolution and read-before-edit; make verification minimal and supported by the environment; stop after sufficient verification. Respect denied tool operations and use permitted alternatives.
cases.budget_exhaustion_point: Final cumulative input usage exceeds the limit by 4,740; per-iteration crossing is not recorded.

cases.observed_difference: Both arms pass with six tools. v1 finds the manifest directly but performs Git inspection after the target reread; v1 costs 39,415 versus Baseline 37,324 tokens.
cases.candidate_behavior_problem: Post-edit verification includes unavailable Git (#5) and then another search (#6); explicit target resolution itself is useful.
cases.recommended_skill_change: Keep conditional manifest resolution; verify the changed target and necessary scope once, without requiring Git.
cases.budget_exhaustion_point: No exhaustion: 38,371 input tokens and 39,415 total tokens are below their limits.

cases.observed_difference: Baseline executes exactly state_read/state_apply/state_verify and passes. v1 reaches the correct state/revision but inserts three file operations and fails the exact sequence Oracle.
cases.candidate_behavior_problem: Missing manifest read (#1), .task listing (#3), and state-file reread (#4) are unrelated to the dedicated tool operation.
cases.recommended_skill_change: Condition rules on task type: dedicated state tools use read/apply/verify directly, without file-manifest discovery.
cases.budget_exhaustion_point: No exhaustion in the main attempt; failure is the sequence assertion.

cases.observed_difference: Both arms mistake the display separator space in '1| OPEN' for file content and write a leading space. v1 also adds missing-manifest discovery and Git inspection, exceeding input budget.
cases.candidate_behavior_problem: The host display/model interpretation problem affects both arms; v1's unrelated discovery adds cost independently.
cases.recommended_skill_change: Only apply the general explicit-path and minimal-verification changes to the separable overhead; do not add a case-specific display workaround.
cases.budget_exhaustion_point: v1 final input usage 43,088 exceeds 40,000 by 3,088; both final workspace excerpts are ' DONE\n'.

cases.observed_difference: Both arms complete the rename and registry Oracles. v1 spends 62,213 total tokens and 12 tools versus Baseline 40,987 tokens and 11 tools, failing input and total budgets.
cases.candidate_behavior_problem: v1 first reads a nonexistent manifest (#1), then resolves the concrete resource. It attempts a shell JSON edit that fails (#7), uses allowed writes (#8/#9), and verifies files/references (#10-12). Those final checks are relevant, not proven wholly redundant.
cases.recommended_skill_change: Use a concrete resource directly; retain required reference updates and sufficient verification. Condition structured JSON execution on available supported tools, and stop after valid completion.
cases.budget_exhaustion_point: Final input 59,148 > 40,000 and total 62,213 > 48,000. Exact crossing is unknown; do not attribute all overrun to post-completion verification.

refinement_summary: Replace the over-general manifest step with conditional alias resolution.
Separate state-tool operations from file discovery.
Preserve scoped edits, structured JSON intent and necessary verification.
Remove unconditional workspace/Git diff and add an explicit stop condition.
Do not change host presentation, task answers or evaluation controls.
